*Source: [Polished Commander & Warleader](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/585170/diamond-polished-spheres-commander-and-warleader-sphere)*

**Note:** This archetype uses content originally published in *Diamond Classes: Kingking*.

*Every good lord's war room staffs the finest tactical minds and genius, strategists able to carefully plan their next move*

## Alignment

A courtly tactician must be monarchist. A courtly tactician who is no longer a monarchist cannot take additional levels in this class.

## Field Policies (Ex)

At 7th level, the courtly tactician selects a single kingking courtier, plus an additional courtier at 13th level and every 6 levels thereafter. The courtly tactician may reselect a single courtier selected this way once per week.

For the purposes of this feature, the courtly tactician treats their effective kingking level as equal to half their courtly tactician level and uses their practitioner modifier as their nobility ability modifier.

**Special - Future Kingking:** The courtly tactician uses the greater of their effective kingking level and their actual kingking level when determining the effects of a courtier granted by field policies. For example, a courtly tactician 10 / kingking 2 would have an effective kingking level of 5 for their field policies courtiers (instead of using their actual kingking level of 2).
